# Keystone Education Alliance — Organization Context

- **Mission:** close the opportunity gap for students in under-resourced communities by providing
  free tutoring, mentoring, and STEM enrichment from middle school through college enrollment.
- **What it does:** runs the flagship [After-School Tutoring Program](../projects/after-school-tutoring.md),
  the [Bright Futures](../projects/bright-futures-fall.md) college-access mentoring cohorts, and
  [STEM Saturdays](../projects/stem-saturdays.md) enrichment. Serves ~1,600 students a year across
  6 school sites and a community learning center.
- **Type / size:** 501(c)(3) public charity; mid-size; ~**$6.8M** annual operating budget; ~55
  staff plus ~300 volunteer tutors/mentors. Headquartered in a mid-size city; founded 2009.
- **Governance:** governed by an 11-member volunteer Board of Directors, chaired by
  [Eleanor Foss](../people/eleanor-foss.md); [James Whitfield](../people/james-whitfield.md) is
  Treasurer. [Camille Navarro](../profile/principal.md) (ED) reports to the board.
- **Leadership team:** four directors report to Cam — Tutoring
  ([Sarah Chen](../people/sarah-chen.md)), College Access & Mentoring
  ([Andre Willis](../people/andre-willis.md)), Development
  ([Daniela Cruz](../people/daniela-cruz.md)), and Finance & Operations
  ([Robert Kim](../people/robert-kim.md)).
- **Key partners & funders:** the [Hearthstone Foundation](../people/diane-alcott.md) (largest
  institutional funder), partner nonprofit [CityReach](../people/marcus-odom.md), and a base of
  individual major donors including [Sarah Whitman](../people/sarah-whitman.md) and
  [Walter Brennan](../people/walter-brennan.md).
- **Strategic focus (FY27):** stabilize program funding, grow the individual-donor base to reduce
  grant dependency, and steward the confidential [Willow](../projects/willow.md) board decision.
